name: legal-dms
description: Legal Document & Matter Management System — Electron desktop shell

scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:build:main && npm run electron:build:preload
scripts.electron:watch: concurrently -k -n tsc,preload "npm run electron:build:main -- --watch" "npm run electron:build:preload -- --watch"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,electron "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run electron:dev"
scripts.build: npm run electron:build && npm --prefix frontend run build
